uncited: - **Degenerate Input:** Pruning based solely on opacity and volume may remove Gaussians critical for fine details if their opacity is low but they cover unique spatial regions.
- **Time Complexity:** Pruning is $O(N)$ to compute scores and select top $K$.
- **Memory Complexity:** Reduced by pruning $N$ to $K$ Gaussians.
